prototype_status.notice: These six tools are migration reference contracts, not tools implemented by the Rust counter prototype.

tools.name: start_task
tools.description:
Start one asynchronous browser task that can interact with external pages.

Call once for a new task, after checking capabilities and agreeing the scope with the user. This launches real work; it is not a preview or an approval. Returns result (including run_id) and pending_proposal, initially often null with reason preparing_admission. Poll get_task; when awaiting_human_admission with a pending proposal, use present_admission with its exact identifiers. If the start response is lost, call get_task without run_id to recover the single retained run. Never retry start_task automatically: a retry can start new work after retention expires. busy means a run is still retained. Tool errors use isError=true and {"error": code}; inspect them before acting.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Bounded browser task: goal/start URL, input values, independent checks, budgets and privacy policy. No caller-supplied approval or grant fields.

fields.name: goal
fields.description: User-agreed browser goal; nonempty after trimming. A goal is not approval for consequential actions.

fields.name: start_url
fields.description: Absolute HTTP(S) starting URL, without userinfo, whitespace or control characters.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: isolated creates an owned browser session; existing_chrome uses the supported existing-browser attachment. Check capabilities.modes first.

fields.name: values
fields.description: Task input values: at most 32 string entries, keys <=128 characters and values <=4000. Use an empty object when no inputs are needed.

fields.name: checks
fields.description: Up to 32 independent completion checks. An empty list cannot establish verified functional completion.

item_fields.name: kind
item_fields.description: Independent check: route/text/value expect a string, visible a boolean, count a nonnegative integer. fixture_state is reserved for trusted adapters and rejected in public requests.

item_fields.name: target
item_fields.description: Empty for route; otherwise a supported CSS selector (up to 512 UTF-8 bytes). XPath and Playwright selector engines are rejected.

item_fields.name: expected
item_fields.description: Exact expected value for the check kind; string, boolean or integer, never a caller assertion that verification passed.

fields.name: viewports
fields.description: One to three CSS-pixel viewport sizes for visual diagnostics.

fields.name: limits
fields.description: Required execution and byte budgets; an empty object uses bounded defaults.

fields.name: max_seconds
fields.description: Finite wall-clock task budget in seconds.

fields.name: max_input_bytes
fields.description: Cumulative provider input budget in bytes.

fields.name: max_output_bytes
fields.description: Cumulative provider output budget in bytes.

fields.name: max_stored_bytes
fields.description: Maximum retained artifact storage in bytes.

fields.name: privacy
fields.description: Required local privacy controls; an empty object uses defaults with image sending disabled.

fields.name: blocked_literals
fields.description: Local payload denylist: up to 32 nonempty literals of 1..256 characters. Never send or log these values.

fields.name: send_images
fields.description: Whether image payloads may be sent to the provider; does not guarantee privacy or grant admission.

fields.name: visual
fields.description: Request visual diagnostics at the selected viewports; separate from functional verification.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description:
Read the current snapshot of one retained task without starting work.

Supply run_id to poll that run; omit it (or pass JSON null) to recover the single retained run after a lost start_task response. Returns result and pending_proposal. queued, awaiting_human_admission and running are not final; reason finalizing means cleanup is still in progress. Present a pending admission only with its exact identifiers; read result.artifact_ids with read_artifact. A terminal outcome_unknown/cleanup_unknown is not proof of successful cleanup. unknown/expired errors mean no matching retained run, not evidence that no browser action occurred. Do not restart automatically.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Exact result.run_id from a task response. Omit or pass JSON null to recover the single retained run after a lost start response; the string 'null' is an ordinary ID.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description:
Request cancellation of a retained browser run and revoke its admission.

Use when the user wants the run stopped. Returns result and pending_proposal; cancellation is a request, not an immediate cleanup receipt or rollback of earlier page changes. Poll get_task until finalization/cleanup finishes. outcome_unknown with cleanup_unknown requires inspection, not a success claim or automatic restart. Repeated cancellation of the same retained run adds no new work; unknown/expired returns isError=true with {"error": code}.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Exact result.run_id of the retained run to stop; obtain it with get_task if the start response was lost.

tools.name: read_artifact
tools.description:
Read retained evidence bytes by server-issued run and artifact IDs.

Use result.artifact_ids from get_task, never a local path. Default legacy is only for a whole artifact fitting one chunk at offset 0; otherwise it returns artifact_range_required. Choose structured or resource for large artifacts. Follow next_offset with the same IDs/channel until eof=true; offset and limit count original bytes, not base64 characters. Explicit channels include total_bytes, sha256 (whole artifact) and chunk_sha256. structured returns base64 in structuredContent.content; resource returns it in content's embedded blob. Errors retain isError=true and {"error": code}, including bad_range for an offset beyond EOF; unknown/expired runs cannot supply retained artifacts.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Exact result.run_id owning the retained artifact.

parameters.name: artifact_id
parameters.description: One ID from result.artifact_ids, not a filesystem path or URL.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based byte offset in the original artifact, not a base64 character offset. For pagination, copy next_offset from the prior response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum original bytes per chunk (1..65536), before base64 encoding.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: legacy: small whole artifact in text and structuredContent; structured: chunk base64 only in structuredContent; resource: chunk base64 in an embedded resource, metadata in structuredContent.

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description:
Inspect local prerequisites and supported operations before starting a task.

Takes no arguments. Returns browser modes, operations, admission classes/mode, artifact chunk limits/channels and selected-provider configuration status. provider_ready and PREREQUISITES_PRESENT describe configuration only: no API, browser, entitlement or human approval is tested. production_ready remains false and live/native evidence remains NOT_RUN. A configured provider does not guarantee successful execution; resolve BLOCKED prerequisites before use. No credentials are returned and this call does not grant admission.

tools.name: present_admission
tools.description:
Present a pending action scope through the client's Standard MCP form.

Call only when get_task reports awaiting_human_admission and a non-null pending_proposal. Copy run_id, proposal_id and digest from that same proposal. The tool presents a form; calling it does not itself grant permission. Only the supported form response may record admission, and a host accept is not proof of a native human click. Never fabricate reviewed/approval/grant fields. Returns the updated result and pending_proposal; continue with get_task. Unsupported form clients fail closed. Stale, resolved or concurrent requests may return isError=true with unknown, presentation_resolved or presentation_busy; refresh get_task instead of blindly repeating a prompt.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Copy pending_proposal.run_id exactly from the latest task snapshot.

parameters.name: proposal_id
parameters.description: Copy pending_proposal.proposal_id exactly; do not reuse an old or resolved proposal.

parameters.name: digest
parameters.description: Copy pending_proposal.digest verbatim: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters binding the displayed scope. Never calculate or guess it.
